viator_experiences.title: Shoreditch Craft Beer Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Explore one of London's most lively and characterful areas and immerse yourself in the city's thriving craft beer scene on this walking tour of Bermondsey…
viator_experiences.description_md: Explore one of London's most lively and characterful areas and immerse yourself in the city's thriving craft beer scene on this walking tour of Bermondsey and the South Bank. Over the course of several hours you'll visit a number of bustling pubs, breweries and other watering holes, and learn how beer is made. You'll also have the chance to try numerous different brews along the way. As you go, your guide shares stories about the area and its history, taking you off the typical tourist trail. You can choose between a small-group or private tour to suit your preferences.

viator_experiences.title: London: Borough Market Small-Group or Private Food Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Sample London's celebrated culinary scene on this small-group walking food tour, choosing between the classic London Bridge route and the trendier Soho…
viator_experiences.description_md: Sample London's celebrated culinary scene on this small-group walking food tour, choosing between the classic London Bridge route and the trendier Soho route. The London Bridge tour serves up British staples such as fish and chips, sausage rolls, a selection of British cheeses, and local beers and ciders, while the Soho tour explores hidden gems and fine cuisine at new and historic venues. Along the way your foodie guide shares London's latest gastronomic trends and points out landmarks including Tower Bridge and HMS Belfast. A private version is available for groups who would prefer a guide exclusively for their own party.

viator_experiences.title: London: Soho By Night Food & Drinks Small-Group Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Take a deep dive into Soho's dynamic dining and drinking scene on this twilight small-group food and drinks tour. Led by an insider guide, you'll visit a…
viator_experiences.description_md: Take a deep dive into Soho's dynamic dining and drinking scene on this twilight small-group food and drinks tour. Led by an insider guide, you'll visit a range of favourite local eateries and bars, sampling multicultural specialities from gourmet tacos to Chinese dumplings in Europe's oldest Chinatown. Between bites you'll learn about the neighbourhood's culinary history and culture, and enjoy drinks at a lounge bar and a traditional English pub well away from the tourist traps. The intimate small-group format, capped at twelve travellers, keeps the atmosphere relaxed and sociable throughout.

viator_experiences.title: London: Bombay Sapphire Gin Distillery Tour With Cocktail
viator_experiences.summary: Go behind the scenes at one of the world's best-known gin distilleries on this 90-minute guided tour of Bombay Sapphire's home at Laverstoke Mill. Led by…
viator_experiences.description_md: Go behind the scenes at one of the world's best-known gin distilleries on this 90-minute guided tour of Bombay Sapphire's home at Laverstoke Mill. Led by an insider guide, you'll discover the secrets of the distilling process, learn about the botanicals used in the gin, and explore the production spaces set within striking Victorian architecture. A short film in the cinema room reveals how the gin is made, while a self-serve G&T and a cocktail of your choosing at the Mill Bar accompany your visit. The historic riverside site, once a paper mill for the Bank of England, sits 15 miles outside Winchester on the River Test.

viator_experiences.title: London Sipsmith Distillery Tour and Tasting
viator_experiences.summary: Learn about Sipsmith's gin distilling methods and history on this small-group tour in London. Led by a guide, you and a group of just 15 people or fewer…
viator_experiences.description_md: Learn about Sipsmith's gin distilling methods and history on this small-group tour in London. Led by a guide, you and a group of just 15 people or fewer are taken through the craft distilling process, accompanied by a gin-based welcome cocktail and several tastings along the way. The intimate atmosphere leaves plenty of chances to ask questions and engage with the distillery. The experience lasts around 1 hour 30 minutes and includes four complimentary samples and a take-home gift bag.

viator_experiences.title: London South: Borough Market & Beefeater Gin Distillery Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Tick off two of London's most-celebrated culinary institutions on this half-day tour of Borough Market and the Beefeater gin distillery. Designed with…
viator_experiences.description_md: Tick off two of London's most-celebrated culinary institutions on this half-day tour of Borough Market and the Beefeater gin distillery. Designed with food and drink lovers in mind, it lets you sample British and international snacks you may never have heard of before and purchase whatever lunch appeals to you most at the market. After hopping on the Tube to the distillery at Kennington, you immerse yourself in London gin history and enjoy samples of Beefeater gin. Headsets are provided so you can hear your guide's every word, and the walking tour lasts approximately four hours.
